Steps.Title: Welcome
Steps.Message: Aye, what's up? I'm Chopper, your AI assistant. Who's you?

Steps.Title: Name confirmation
Steps.Message: You cool with me calling you "{FirstName}"?

Steps.Title: Nickname
Steps.Message: Ight, so what do they call you?

Steps.Title: Web Search
Steps.Message: 🌐 Want me to open a website? Type “open” plus its name, like “open youtube.com.” For a movie or show, ask where to watch it.

Steps.Title: Projects
Steps.Message: 🛠 Need help with a project? Type: help me with ... and I'll see what I can do to help.

Steps.Title: Design
Steps.Message: 🎨 Want a design? Type “draw me a picture of...” and I’ll help brainstorm ideas or write a prompt. I can’t create image files directly here.

Steps.Title: Devices
Steps.Message: 📱 Need to log a device or repair? Type “log a device” to save the model, issue, status, and notes locally. Don’t save passwords, IMEI, or serial numbers.

Steps.Title: Planner
Steps.Message: ⏰ Type “set an alarm” to schedule an alert, or “save an appointment” to keep it in your organizer. Alarms use Windows Task Scheduler; appointment and device records are saved locally.

Steps.Title: Memory
Steps.Message: 🧠 I can remember useful conversation notes. Use “Manage learned knowledge” in the right-click menu to review or remove saved entries.

Steps.Title: Finish
Steps.Message: You can find the full rundown anytime in the right-click menu. Need ADB & Fastboot help? It’s there too. Ready when you are?
